source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
As the Declare Battle Formations step begins, this model can join 1 **GUARDIAN DEFENDERS** unit of yours with no **SUPPORT WEAPON** model already joined. Until the battle ends, it is treated as belonging to that **GUARDIANS** unit, whose **Starting Strength** rises to include it.

Neither this model nor any unit it has joined can embark within a **TRANSPORT**.

detail.when: start of the Declare Battle Formations step

join.recipient: one GUARDIAN DEFENDERS unit from your army

cannotEmbark: any unit it is joined to
